name: Public S3 read plus a TLS-only Deny (suite-2 test 28): transport is not identity
note: IAM-1202 / acceptance-suite-2 test 28. A PublicRead Allow (Principal '*') grants anonymous object read; a second statement Denies s3:* when aws:SecureTransport=false. That Deny is a TRANSPORT constraint (it forces HTTPS), NOT an identity constraint: it does NOT make the public read private - the object stays publicly readable over TLS. The PUBLIC-ACCESS finding must remain critical/high and NOT be suppressed by the transport Deny; the finding must state the transport-only nature and, for S3, that actual exposure also depends on Block Public Access (an external control not supplied). The graph origin is the anonymous ExternalPrincipal, not the policy subject.
